name: Tinbox
summary: A bold sticker-style money app for a small shop, with a cash drawer counter and pourable jars
about: A money app for a small shop with accounts, cards, budgets and savings, shown with a general store's sample data. It looks like chunky yellow stickers on a dotted page, counts the cash drawer note by note and deposits it with a confirm step. Budgets are glass jars with sloshing liquid: drag one jar onto another to pour money across, and savings goals fill up as you add to them.
how: Count the cash drawer with the plus and minus buttons, then deposit some of it to the bank
Drag a budget jar onto another jar to pour money between them, or use its Pour button
Add to or take from savings goals and watch the jars fill and empty
Move money or pay a supplier with a check-and-send step
Freeze a card, switch online and cash-machine use, set a limit or make a virtual card
Change a transaction's category and see the jars and reports update
